# Enhanced Trade Share Link Management

## Summary

Extends the trade sharing feature to support multiple share links per trade with customizable expiration dates and comprehensive link management capabilities.

## Changes

### :dart: Core Features

• *Multiple Share Links*: Users can now create multiple share links for the same trade
• *Custom Expirations*: Set expiration dates via presets (30 days, 90 days, 1 year, never)
• *Link Management*: Create, update expiration, and delete share links with confirmation
• *Auto-generation*: First link automatically generated on initial modal open (not after deletions)

### :art: UI/UX Improvements

• *Mobile Responsive*: Modal and link items adapt to mobile screens (320px+)
• *Scrollable List*: Fixed height scroll area activates when >3 links exist
• *Clickable Links*: Click anywhere on link item (except action buttons) to copy
• *Visual Feedback*: Check icon appears when link is copied
• *Exposed Actions*: Change expiration and delete buttons directly visible
• *Keyboard Support*: Enter/Space keys work on clickable link areas
• *Hover States*: Dropdown menu items now highlight on hover

### :wrench: Technical Implementation

#### New Components

• `ShareLinkItem.tsx`: Individual link display with actions
• `expirationPresets.ts`: Utility for calculating expiration dates

#### API Endpoints

• `GET /api/trade-shares?tradeId={id}`: Fetch all active share links
• `PATCH /api/trade-shares/[shareCode]`: Update link expiration
• `DELETE /api/trade-shares/[shareCode]`: Deactivate share link

#### Database

• Extended default expiration from 30 to 90 days
• Added client-side API wrapper functions
• Server-side functions for link management

### :earth_africa: Internationalization

• Added operation-specific error messages (en/de):  
   • `failedToUpdateExpiration`  
   • `failedToDeleteLink`  
   • `failedToCreateLink`  
   • `linkCreated`
• Updated modal title: "Your Share Links for This Trade"
• Generic warning message (no fixed expiration mention)

### :wheelchair: Accessibility

• ARIA labels for interactive elements
• Keyboard navigation support (Enter/Space)
• Screen reader friendly
• No ESLint accessibility errors

## Testing

### Manual Testing Checklist

• Create multiple share links
• Update expiration dates (all presets)
• Delete links with confirmation
• Copy link by clicking anywhere on item
• Copy button shows check icon feedback
• Scroll works with 5+ links
• Mobile responsive (320px - 768px)
• Keyboard navigation (Enter/Space to copy)
• Dropdown hover highlights work
• Auto-generation only on initial open when there is no link available
• Toast notifications for all operations
• Error messages are operation-specific

### Browser Compatibility

• Chrome :white_check_mark:
• Safari :white_check_mark:
• Firefox :white_check_mark:
• Mobile browsers :white_check_mark:

## Screenshots

_Please add screenshots showing:_

1. Multiple share links with different expirations
2. Delete confirmation dialog
3. Mobile responsive view
4. Hover state on dropdown items

## Breaking Changes

None - backwards compatible with existing share links

## Related

• Shortcut Ticket: [SC-3496]
• Original 90-day extension commit: `57a04c0f`

## Deployment Notes

• No database migrations required
• Existing share links will continue to work
• New features available immediately after deployment

## Summary

Implements CSV export functionality for the all-trades table with a split-button dropdown interface, allowing users to export their trade data for external analysis in Excel or other tools.

*Key Features:*

• Export filtered trades with visible columns (default)
• Export all trades with all columns option
• Smart button states: main button disabled when no filtered data, dropdown remains accessible
• Clean data formatting optimized for spreadsheet applications

## Changes

### New Components & Utilities

• *ExportCSVButton.tsx*: Split-button component with dropdown for export options
• *csvUtils.ts*: Generic CSV utilities (supports both export and future import)
• *tradeExportConfig.ts*: Trade-specific export column configuration

### Data Format Improvements

• Currency values exported as plain numbers (e.g., `150.50` instead of `+$150.50`)
• Added Currency column showing "USD" (future-proof for multi-currency)
• Days columns export numbers with "(days)" unit in header
• All monetary fields use consistent 2-decimal formatting

### Translations

• English and German translations with dynamic trade counts
• Dropdown descriptions: "Export X filtered trade(s) with visible columns"

### Technical Details

• Uses papaparse library for robust CSV generation with proper escaping
• Generic utilities architecture supports future CSV import feature
• Respects table filters and column visibility settings
• Filename includes timestamp: `trades_export_2026-01-27.csv`

## Acceptance Criteria Met

:white_check_mark: Given I have trade data, when I click export, then I can download a properly formatted CSV file  
:white_check_mark: Given I export data, when I open the file, then all relevant trade fields are included  
:white_check_mark: Given I filter my trades, when I export, then only the filtered trades are included

## Testing

• Export filtered trades with visible columns
• Export all trades with all columns
• Verify button disabled when no filtered data
• Check dropdown remains accessible when main button disabled
• Open CSV in Excel/Sheets and verify clean number formatting
• Verify Currency column shows "USD"
• Test with German language translations
